hints.voice: test -d source/src || { mkdir -p source && cp -r {SKILL}/assets/template/. source/; }; test -d source/node_modules || (cd source && npm ci --no-audit --no-fund); python3 {S}/voice.py --project . --emit source/timing.js
hints.visuals: Edit source/src/film/world.js (what is on screen) and source/src/film/shots.js (when: every keyframe keyed to line ids; guide: {SKILL}/references/theatre-guide.md). Then: node {S}/theatre_look.mjs   (npm run build + coverage report + one still per chapter and per line + contact sheets, all in stills/). Fix every line listed under 'NOTHING changes'. Open stills/sheet-*.png and every still with Read, fix, re-run. Check text size and contrast: python3 {S}/legibility.py --project . (fix every red box in stills/legibility/, re-shoot, re-run), then: python3 {S}/vstate.py attest visuals "<what you checked and fixed>"
hints.render: (cd source && npm run build) && node {S}/capture.mjs --page source/index.html --bench 3   (fps + ETA), then in the background: mkdir -p build && node {S}/capture.mjs --page source/index.html --out build/silent.mp4 --workers 2 --max-minutes 100 > build/render.log 2>&1   (up to --workers 4 on an unshared machine). Poll: tail -n 3 build/render.log. Exit 3 = budget reached: run the same command again (finished segments are kept) until the log says 'wrote'. Then: python3 {S}/vstate.py advance
